text:
olivia: FYI we've got an invoice from BalticCloud Solutions AB (SE) for 45,000 SEK. They included 25% VAT but their VAT number fails VIES. Vendor portal: https://vendors.example.com/balticcloud/invoice/BC-2026-912

emma: Can you paste the invoice details? Need to confirm amounts and whether it's recurring subscription or one-off professional services.

olivia: Invoice lines: 
```
Vendor: BalticCloud Solutions AB
Vendor VAT: SE123456789009
Invoice#: BC-2026-912
Service: 3 x Dedicated GPU months
Amount ex VAT: 36,000 SEK
VAT @25%: 9,000 SEK
Total: 45,000 SEK
```

karim: If this is B2B and they're in Sweden, the correct treatment is reverse charge. The fact the VAT number didn't validate is a red flag. We should not accept VAT being charged without valid VAT ID.

tax-ops: Confirmed VIES check returns no match for SE123456789009. Recommend request: 1) Swedish VAT registration certificate or Bolagsverket extract; 2) Corrected invoice showing net amount and reference to reverse charge; 3) Provide their billing legal name and registry number to match vendor onboarding record.

legal: If they're claiming they were charged VAT in error, we can accept a signed indemnity for taxes for one-off cases but prefer corrected invoice. Also check local Swedish rules for domestic suppliers issuing VAT incorrectly (penalties/fines stay with vendor).

emma: Operational question: do we pay the net and hold the VAT on a payable code? We could pay net now and place the VAT on a suspense account until vendor proves registration. Need sign-off from accounting lead.

arun: (accounting lead): We can pay net and block the VAT line with a suspense GL. But AP needs a written note on ticket. Avoid gross-ups. If vendor reissues, we clear suspense.

olivia: I'll ask vendor to reissue and attach registry docs. I'll include the wording: "Please supply Swedish VAT registration evidence or reissue invoice net of VAT with 'Reverse charge - article 196' and include our VAT ID: EU123456789."

emma: Thanks. Please tag me if vendor pushes on receiving the full amount.

olivia: Closing after response.
